DemoReset.title: DemoReset
DemoReset.description: The demo after a reset: rows loaded per table, and the flags with their starting triage.

EngineRun.title: EngineRun
EngineRun.description: What re-running the rules changed. Open flags that no longer fire are removed; triaged ones are kept.

role.description: Which side of the review `person` was on; null for team-level flags.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Rule-specific facts behind the flag; keys depend on `rule_key`.

FlagRole.title: FlagRole
FlagRole.description: Which side of the review a flagged person was on.

note.title: Note
note.description: Omit to keep the current note; null or blank clears it.

dismiss_reason.title: Dismiss Reason
dismiss_reason.description: Required when dismissing; cleared for any other status.

good.title: Good
good.description: coverage: merged PRs approved by someone other than the author before merging; depth: big-PR approvals that are not rubber stamps; escapes: approved merged PRs with no revert or hotfix; responsiveness: review requests answered (or the PR merged) within the stale threshold; load_balance: reviews done by everyone except the two busiest developers.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0-100; null when there was nothing to measure, and the other parts share its weight.

HealthPart.title: HealthPart
HealthPart.description: One part of the health score. `good` of `total` went well; how that maps to `score` depends on the part.

score.title: Score
score.description: Weighted average of the parts' scores, 0-100; null when no part could be measured.

week_starts.title: Week Starts
week_starts.description: Oldest first. Each week is the 7 days after its start; the last one ends at as_of.

team_reviews.title: Team Reviews
team_reviews.description: Reviews by all developers in the window (the manager is not counted).

top2_share.title: Top2 Share
top2_share.description: Share of team_reviews done by the two busiest developers.

concentrated.title: Concentrated
concentrated.description: Whether the load_concentration rule fires on these numbers.

weekly.title: Weekly
weekly.description: Reviews per week, aligned with LoadReport.week_starts.

median_multiple.title: Median Multiple
median_multiple.description: reviews / team_median; null when the median is 0.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Review requests waiting on this person now.

oldest_pending_hours.title: Oldest Pending Hours
oldest_pending_hours.description: Age of the oldest waiting request; null if none.

escape_rate_floor.title: Escape Rate Floor
escape_rate_floor.description: An escape rate at or above this scores 0 on the escapes part.

top2_share_threshold.title: Top2 Share Threshold
top2_share_threshold.description: Load balance scores 100 while the top two do at most this share.

stale_after_hours.title: Stale After Hours
stale_after_hours.description: Responsiveness counts a request answered within this many hours.

trend.title: Trend
trend.description: The score as it stood at the end of each of the last `weeks` weeks, oldest first. Earlier weeks whose window starts before the first PR are left out; the last point is always `as_of`.

open_flags.title: Open Flags
open_flags.description: Flags not yet acknowledged or dismissed, at any age.

median_hours_to_first_review.title: Median Hours To First Review
median_hours_to_first_review.description: PRs opened in the window: median hours until someone other than the author reviewed.

waiting_reviews.title: Waiting Reviews
waiting_reviews.description: Review requests still unanswered on unmerged PRs.

stale_reviews.title: Stale Reviews
stale_reviews.description: Of those, how many have waited past the stale threshold.

count.title: Count
count.description: Non-dismissed flags of this rule inside the window.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Waiting longer than the stale_backlog threshold.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: Active repeat patterns, computed now; dismissed flags don't count.

review_debt.title: Review Debt
review_debt.description: Review requests waiting on this person, oldest first.

QualityMedians.title: QualityMedians
QualityMedians.description: Medians across developers who have a value; null when nobody does.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Reviews submitted in the period, any verdict.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: PRs approved in the period (a re-approval of the same PR counts once).

minutes_per_100_lines.title: Minutes Per 100 Lines
minutes_per_100_lines.description: Median minutes from PR opened to first approval, per 100 changed lines; null with no approvals.

comments_per_100_lines.title: Comments Per 100 Lines
comments_per_100_lines.description: Comments per 100 lines of the PRs reviewed.

substantive_share.title: Substantive Share
substantive_share.description: Share of comments that are substantive (the rubber_stamp rule's test); null with no comments.

big_approvals.title: Big Approvals
big_approvals.description: Approved PRs at or over the rubber_stamp size threshold.

stamped_big_approvals.title: Stamped Big Approvals
stamped_big_approvals.description: Of those, how many the rubber_stamp rule would flag.

escapes.title: Escapes
escapes.description: Of those, how many needed a revert or hotfix within the escape window.

escape_rate.title: Escape Rate
escape_rate.description: escapes / approved_merged; null when nothing approved was merged.

team_reviews.title: Team Reviews
team_reviews.description: Reviews by all developers in the window (the manager is not counted).

team_median.title: Team Median
team_median.description: Median reviews per developer in the window.

over_median_multiple.title: Over Median Multiple
over_median_multiple.description: reviews_given is above the load_concentration rule's multiple of the team median.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Non-dismissed flags in this role, by rule; rules with none are left out.

open.title: Open
open.description: How many of those are still open (not yet acknowledged).

rubber_stamp_min_lines.title: Rubber Stamp Min Lines
rubber_stamp_min_lines.description: rubber_stamp: PRs with at least this many changed lines.

rubber_stamp_max_seconds.title: Rubber Stamp Max Seconds
rubber_stamp_max_seconds.description: rubber_stamp: an approval faster than this is a stamp.

substantive_min_chars.title: Substantive Min Chars
substantive_min_chars.description: Substantive: a line comment at least this long...

stock_phrases.title: Stock Phrases
stock_phrases.description: ...and not one of these phrases (case-insensitive). Sorted, unique.

escape_window_days.title: Escape Window Days
escape_window_days.description: escape: a fix within this many days of merge.

stale_after_hours.title: Stale After Hours
stale_after_hours.description: stale_backlog: a review request unanswered for longer than this.

load_top2_share.title: Load Top2 Share
load_top2_share.description: load_concentration: top two reviewers above this share.

load_median_multiple.title: Load Median Multiple
load_median_multiple.description: load_concentration: or anyone above this × median.

pattern_window_days.title: Pattern Window Days
pattern_window_days.description: Repeat pattern: flags of one rule in this window...

health_window_days.title: Health Window Days
health_window_days.description: Health score: measured over this many days.

health_escape_rate_floor.title: Health Escape Rate Floor
health_escape_rate_floor.description: Health score: an escape rate this high scores 0.

RuleSettings.title: RuleSettings
RuleSettings.description: Every rule threshold and health score weight; the same fields as the backend's RuleParams.
